findings.current: Repentance. A cave for repentance. Repentance Cave was where criminals were confined.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the source’s deliberate explanation of the two Sino-Korean characters with a tautology, losing the meaning of shame and remorse.
findings.rationale: The source separately glosses 참 as shame and 회 as remorse to frame Unnamed’s guilt.
findings.replacement: The first character meant shame; the second, remorse. Repentance Cave was where criminals were confined.
findings.source: 부끄러울 참. 뉘우칠 회. 참회동은 죄인을 가두는 곳이다.

findings.current: Perhaps it was regret over failing to prevent his Master’s death. Unnamed had spent three months there, considering himself a sinner who had failed not only to protect his Master, but also the Green Jade Buddha Staff, Shaolin’s sacred treasure entrusted to him before his Master’s death.
findings.defect: The draft makes Unnamed explicitly consider himself a sinner for failing to protect his Master, whereas the source separately presents that as presumed regret and identifies his self-professed sin as failing to protect even the entrusted staff. It also replaces the Buddhist and euphemistic references to Nirvana and passing away with explicit death.
findings.rationale: The source distinguishes Taekyung’s inference about Hong Dao’s Nirvana from Unnamed’s guilt over losing the Green Jade Buddha Staff and preserves Buddhist register.
findings.replacement: Perhaps he regretted failing to prevent his Master from entering Nirvana. Unnamed had spent three months there, considering himself a sinner because he had failed to protect even the Green Jade Buddha Staff, the sacred treasure of Shaolin that his Master had entrusted to him before passing away.
findings.source: 그건 아마도 스승의 열반을 막지 못한 후회가 아니었을까. 무명은 스승이 떠나기 전 맡기고 간 소림의 신물, 녹옥불장(綠玉佛杖)마저 지켜 내지 못한 죄인을 자처하며 그곳에서 석 달이라는 시간을 보낸 것이다.

findings.current: It was a bruise that would never fade.
findings.defect: The draft turns a figurative, lifelong yoke into a literal permanent bruise.
findings.rationale: 멍에 means a yoke or enduring burden here, referring to the psychological burden represented by the scar rather than merely its discoloration.
findings.replacement: It was also a yoke he would never be free of.

findings.current: *I should have been a little stronger. Then I could have protected my Master. I could have carried out his final request properly.*
findings.defect: The draft formats Unnamed’s spoken dialogue as an unspoken internal thought, changing the scene action and removing his explicit statement that these were the thoughts he had in the cave.
findings.rationale: The Korean is enclosed in dialogue quotation marks and ends with 하는 생각 말입니다, explicitly identifying what Unnamed is telling Taekyung he thought.
findings.replacement: “I kept thinking that if only I had been a little stronger, I could have protected my Master. I could have properly carried out his final request.”
findings.source: “조금만 더 강했더라면 스승님을 지킬 수 있었을 텐데, 그분의 마지막 당부를 잘 수행할 수 있었을 텐데, 하는 생각 말입니다.”

findings.current: “The two of you have probably never met face-to-face. He is my Senior Brother by lineage, but he has been Abbot for less than a month, so it would be understandable if you did not know him.”
findings.defect: The draft omits 대사형, the eldest Senior Brother, weakening the Abbot’s specific position in Unnamed’s martial hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 대사형 identifies the eldest among one’s Senior Brothers, not merely any Senior Brother.
findings.replacement: “The two of you have probably never met face-to-face. In our lineage, he is my eldest Senior Brother, but he has been Abbot for less than a month, so it is only natural that you would not know him.”
findings.source: 두 분이 직접 마주친 적은 없을 겁니다. 소승에게는 항렬상으로 대사형이 되시는 분인데, 방장직에 오르신 것도 불과 한 달이 채 되지 않았으니 진 시주께서 모르실 법도 합니다.

findings.current: My Master, who must be watching over us from somewhere, would have been relieved to see his friend in good health.
findings.defect: The draft changes the object of Hong Dao’s watchfulness from Unnamed specifically to the collective “us.”
findings.rationale: 소승을 explicitly means that Hong Dao is watching over Unnamed, preserving the personal master-disciple relationship.
findings.replacement: My Master, who must be watching over me from somewhere, would have been relieved to see his friend in good health.
findings.source: 어딘가에서 소승을 지켜보고 계실 스승님께서도 건강해진 친우분의 모습에 안도하셨겠지요.

findings.current: It was only funny when someone who had suffered appropriately made a joke like that. When Unnamed said it, the mood could only turn solemn in an instant.
findings.defect: “Suffered appropriately” is an unnatural literal collocation that obscures Taekyung’s point that this joke only works when the speaker has not suffered nearly as much as Unnamed.
findings.rationale: 정도껏 here means within reasonable limits; the humor fails because Unnamed’s suffering was too severe for the self-deprecation to remain light.
findings.replacement: A joke like that was only funny when it came from someone who hadn’t suffered quite so much. When Unnamed said it, the mood could only turn solemn in an instant.
findings.source: 고생도 정도껏 한 사람이 저런 드립을 쳐야 웃긴 거지, 무명이 이런 말을 하면 단번에 분위기가 숙연해질 수밖에 없다.

findings.current: “We are at an inn near Mount Song. It was rented in the name of the Murim Alliance, so please rest here as long as you wish.”
findings.defect: The draft adds permission to remain indefinitely, which the source does not state.
findings.rationale: 푹 쉬시며 머무르십시오 invites Taekyung to stay and rest comfortably; it does not specify that he may remain for as long as he wants.
findings.replacement: “We are at an inn near Mount Song. It was rented in the name of the Murim Alliance, so please stay here and get plenty of rest.”
findings.source: 숭산 인근의 객잔입니다. 무림맹의 이름으로 빌린 것이니 푹 쉬시며 머무르십시오.

findings.current: A Murim practitioner with a Hyeopbong sword at his waist. Another carrying a massive saber on his back without even a scabbard. Others carrying spears and twin axes…
findings.defect: The draft leaves the ordinary descriptive weapon term 협봉검 as an unexplained hybrid romanization.
findings.rationale: 협봉검 describes a narrow-bladed sword rather than supplying an established proper name that should remain romanized.
findings.replacement: A Murim practitioner with a narrow-bladed sword at his waist. Another carrying a massive saber on his back without even a scabbard. Others carrying spears and twin axes…
findings.source: 협봉검을 찬 무림인, 커다란 대도(大刀)를 검갑도 없이 등에 짊어진 무림인, 창과 쌍부를 든 무림인…….

findings.current: I was muttering to myself when a group of Murim practitioners crossing the main road suddenly caught my eye.
findings.defect: The draft presents Taekyung as audibly muttering, while 속으로 explicitly marks the words as internal.
findings.rationale: 속으로 distinguishes an internal thought from spoken muttering.
findings.replacement: As I thought that to myself, a group of Murim practitioners crossing the main road suddenly caught my eye.
findings.source: 속으로 중얼거리던 그때, 대로변을 가로지르는 한 무리의 무림인이 문득 눈에 걸렸다.

summary: Several fidelity defects alter Unnamed’s guilt, turn spoken dialogue into internal thought, lose hierarchy, and change specific imagery or actions; additional localized wording needs correction.
